claims.harm: During the REDOWNLOAD phase, presync work stops growing and timeout renewals cease, risking eviction of slow peers before the redownload buffer releases headers.
claims.quote: A peer that needs timeout renewals during presync therefore has only 22–42 minutes after the transition to deliver those headers before being disconnected.

status_by.quote: Renewals: now bounded by `MAX_HEADERS_SYNC_TIMEOUT_RENEWALS = 6`, so a peer can hold the slot for at most ~2h22m through this path.
